messages:
Maya (AE): FYI — Mediva just replied: they will only accept vendor invoices with PO + cost center. They prefer GCP Marketplace for pricing transparency but their AP rules require Redwood to be the invoicing vendor. Can we do marketplace AND Redwood invoice?

Connor (SE): Short: not normally. Marketplace purchases are invoiced by GCP. We can grant entitlements for seats but we can't generate the vendor invoice in Marketplace flow.

Hannah (Finance): Confirming. GCP invoices customers for marketplace buys. If they insist on Redwood invoice we need a direct contract (SOW + invoice cadence). Also need to review a requested 28% discount on a 12-month, 15-seat commit (~$180k list). That discount >25% requires deal desk approval.

Maya (AE): They asked for 15 seats, 12mo, 28% off list. Do we have any fast reseller path?

Vik (Legal): Reseller could invoice, but we'd need a quick partner agreement + revenue share. That takes some review but might be faster than full vendor onboarding. Also flag: health vertical, need BAAs/Security addendum.

gcp-marketplace-bot: Private Offer created: OFFER-100312 - https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/privateOffers/OFFER-100312 (automated)

Hannah (Finance): Quick options to present to Mediva:
1) GCP Private Offer — fastest, GCP invoices. We can offer 25% max without special approvals.
2) Direct Redwood Invoice — meets PO requirement, slower (legal + billing config ~5-10 business days), discount negotiable up to requested if deal desk approves.
3) Reseller partner — medium speed, partner invoices and includes PO; revenue share applies.

Connor (SE): POC note: if they go GCP private offer, we can stand up a sandbox in 4 business days and map entitlements for 15 seats. If they require direct billing, we'll need Dedicated or Private deployment manifest.

Maya (AE): Action items: (1) Hannah open Deal Desk for >25% discount and attach ARR calc, (2) Vik scope quick BAA + SOC2 checklist, (3) Connor prep lightweight POC manifest for marketplace path. I'll tell Mediva to pick preferred path; they want kick-off next week.

Hannah (Finance): Deal desk ticket opened: DEAL-2411. I attached margin impact and suggested counter: 25% + NET45 or 28% with 6-month prepay.

Vik (Legal): I'll draft BAA + addendum and estimate review in 3 business days.

Maya (AE): Thanks team — ping here with updates. I'll note timelines in the customer email. :thumbsup:
